run_build_statistics: run the python script to fetch Jenkins build statistics and upload results to BigQuery
scrape_for_known_errors: scrape Jenkins console HTML output to find and count occurrences of known error patterns
process_build: process a Jenkins build by parsing test report JSON and console output for pass and failure counts
process_matrix: process a Jenkins matrix build by iterating over matrix runs and collecting per-configuration test results
get_last_processed_buildnumber: query BigQuery to retrieve the last processed build number for a given Jenkins job name
